supplement_requirements.catalog_preparation: Check benchmark_nvidia_cudnn --catalog and the supplementary collector catalogs first. Extend the missing reference paths and validate correctness before collecting timings.

timing.exclusions: Compilation, initialization, data transfers and correctness checks are outside the timed region.

supplement_requirements.validation: Use CPU oracles under FlagDNN/reference and record full numerical or byte-exact validation. Check correctness before timing, after timing and after resetting outputs and replaying the graph; verify inputs and padding remain unchanged.
supplement_requirements.evidence: Provide exact case metadata, actual reference provider, support status, timing configuration and samples, validation results, source revision, device/software versions, raw evidence paths and SHA256 hashes.
supplement_requirements.unsupported_policy: Keep unavailable records with concrete reasons when the native provider cannot implement the exact semantics. Do not invent timings. Any alternative NVIDIA provider needs explicit attribution, independent evidence and a matching contract; do not label it as cuDNN.
